restartUnavailable: Decoder runner is not available yet
triggerUnavailableHint: Analyzer Trigger is not available for this device
protocolTriggerIntro: Match communication content while capturing. Uses the selected analyzer’s channel and protocol settings.
protocolTriggerAddAnalyzer: Add and configure an Async Serial, I2C or SPI analyzer first.
protocolTriggerI2cHint: NACK matches address or data NACK. A data filter matches only data NACKs. Normal read completion can also produce NACK.
protocolTriggerSequenceHint: Separate values with spaces, e.g. AA 55 01. T0 is the start of the last matching value. SPI sequences reset when chip select is released.
protocolTriggerBudgetHint: Use Looping (Stream) capture and disable hardware triggers. Waiting is limited by the capture memory budget. The complete matched value is always retained.
protocolTriggerCollecting: Protocol matched; collecting the remaining waveform…
protocolTriggerShortPre: Less pre-trigger history was available than requested.

protocolTriggerError.desktopOnly: Protocol triggers are available in the desktop app. Browser and WebUSB captures do not support this mode.
protocolTriggerError.select: Select a configured Async Serial, I2C or SPI analyzer.
protocolTriggerError.stream: Select Looping (Stream) capture in Device Settings to use a protocol trigger.
protocolTriggerError.hardware: Disable hardware trigger, external trigger and trigger output before using a protocol trigger.
protocolTriggerError.duration: Enter whole milliseconds: before/after 0–60000, maximum wait 1–3600000.
protocolTriggerError.hex: Enter hexadecimal values separated by spaces or commas, e.g. AA 55 01.
protocolTriggerError.length: Enter 1–64 values; address and data filters accept one value.
protocolTriggerError.value: A hexadecimal value is outside the selected protocol’s range.
protocolTriggerError.channels: All analyzer channels must be distinct, valid and enabled for capture.
protocolTriggerError.uartFormat: UART triggers support 5–8 data bits, none/even/odd parity and 1/1.5/2 stop bits.
protocolTriggerError.uartRate: UART triggers require a valid baud rate and a sampling rate at least 8 times the baud rate.
protocolTriggerError.spiFormat: SPI trigger configuration supports 1–32 bits per word.
protocolTriggerError.spiLine: Configure the selected MOSI or MISO channel in the analyzer first.
protocolTriggerError.rawFormat: PXLogic protocol triggers require decoded channel samples. Restore the default capture format instead of raw USB data.

protocolTriggerResult.matched: Protocol trigger matched; the requested waveform was retained.
protocolTriggerResult.timed_out: Maximum wait reached without a protocol match. Captured data was retained.
protocolTriggerResult.stopped_without_match: Capture stopped without a protocol match. Captured data was retained.
protocolTriggerResult.buffer_limit: Capture memory limit reached without a protocol match. Captured data was retained.
protocolTriggerResult.incomplete: Protocol matched, but capture ended before the requested post-trigger window was complete.
